verdict.rationale: Adyen can include which risk rules triggered, and whether a payment went to case management, in the payment response and webhooks. This gives analysts a rule-level explanation of why a transaction was flagged. The ML-driven scoring is described only as AI evaluating fraud risk against global data, with no evidence that each score comes with its top contributing factors. Missing for 10: per-score top-factor or feature-attribution explanations for the ML model, documentation of reason codes on every score, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
